findings.title: Recorded ISRCTN identifier omitted from Registry column
findings.why: The Registry cell displays '--' although this trial row has a recorded ISRCTN identifier. The renderer recognizes only NCT identifiers.
findings.fix: Display recorded ISRCTN identifiers in the Registry column as well as NCT identifiers.

findings.title: Extraction introduction calls refused trial inputs pooled numbers
findings.page_quote: Every pooled number on this page, with the passage it was read from,

evidence.quote: "detail": "k=2 pooled row refused because point estimates are on opposite sides of the null"

findings.why: The table contains individual trial estimates for an outcome whose pooled result was refused. Its introduction implies those numbers were pooled, conflicting with the recorded refusal and the Analysis tab.
findings.fix: Describe these as recorded trial inputs and identify the outcome's synthesis state.
